title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 34
paragraphs: Passing by Parapotamioi, the barbarians came to Panopeus, and from that point on their army split and went different ways. The largest and strongest portion, proceeding with Xerxes himself against Athens, entered the land of the Boeotians, coming into the territory of Orchomenos. Now the general body of the Boeotians was taking the side of the Medes, and their cities were being held by Macedonians appointed for each, sent by Alexander. They were holding them with this aim: to make it plain to Xerxes that the Boeotians were disposed toward the Median cause.
